S.basis: Spotrac team payroll pages; Cycle 41 established the cached pages are the 2027 payroll (file name/metadata still say 2026 — flagged, not rewritten)
S.exclusion_reconciliation: Cycle 41's 501 pre-arb / 209 arb counts described the subset of Spotrac rows with no Cot's LRP-2027 counterpart (777 rows). HS-1's reproducible whole-file rule is broader and more conservative: it excludes every Pre-Arbitration row at the flat $1,000,000 (553) and every non-Bypassed Arbitration row (219) as placeholders/projections.

C.basis: Cot's Baseball Contracts (Baseball Prospectus) Labor Relations Payroll 2027: deferred money at present value; option years at the guaranteed buyout
C.salary_field: salary_lrp_2027, summed over a player's player-team rows (obligations to the same player from multiple clubs are one player's pay)

limits: active-contract cross-section, not newly signed FA contracts
skills are 2027 projections (expectations), with realized-2026 descriptives as sensitivity
pitchers out of scope; two-way players excluded
Sample S covers 24 of 30 teams (Spotrac snapshot); Sample C covers 30 teams but only players with published Cot's dollar figures who also sit in the Marcel 201
